summary: 20 units reviewed (P1, 1-19). Word splits, sandhi, glosses and grammar labels are sound throughout; no token mismatches, no invented variants, no text_flags needed, confidence 'high' is justified for every unit. 8 units need fixes, all in the translations: 2 error-severity (unit 2 bracketed gloss inside the Hindi; unit 9 'साक्षात्' added with no Sanskrit support) and 7 minor (unit 2 'divine' added in English; unit 3 bracketed carry-over clause in the Hindi; unit 8 alternative reading of enām praṣṭum unrecorded; unit 14 'वंश' added; units 15 and 17 'स्थित' added for sahitam; unit 18 English drops the 'and' of ete cānye and disagrees with the Hindi). No regrouping suggested; the three-line units 3, 13 and 14 follow the edition.
